manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp338-339 and 439-441 ties task-referenced ItemRepair activation to the referenced Tasks.TCID/TLID and selected APID's MaintenanceAllocation station. TaskLevel maps TLID to LEVL; in this matrix BASE has LEVL1 and ALT has LEVL2, so a positive result is level-aware binding, not an isolated proof that the TLID string alone caused it. Both Station.LEVL fields are blank.
controlled_design: Both ItemRepair station rows always reference fixed task ID I01-LRU-DIRP of TCID LRU-CM, with equal one-hour repair. The two task rows have equal neutral description, TCID LRU-CM and empty NOTE; TID B=I01-LEVEL-B is inert. The alternate source layer swaps only their Tasks.TLID cells between BASE and ALT. Both APIDs allocate both TLIDs with crossed stations: AIR_BASIC BASE→BASE and ALT→DEPOT; AIR_DEPOT BASE→DEPOT and ALT→BASE. Stock is BASE1/DEPOT0 under both APIDs. Four inputs cross source layer and APID; within a layer only Control.APID and description change, while within an APID only the two Tasks.TLID cells and description change. No ItemReorder or ResourceAllocation business rows.

pre_run_hypotheses.common: All four runs should convert without error, reproduce the same first physical LRU ID1 failure h9.8829, base spare ID0 draw h10, aircraft readiness h10.5, and exact 24-table authored roundtrip. Any difference is diagnostic until explained.

pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter may reject alternate level/unused task rows, or engine may choose different repair routing. Preserve contrary runs as diagnostics and do not publish positive level-aware binding without all four matched physical traces and independent replay.

limits: This is bounded task-level-aware binding and APID interaction for one LRU, two TLIDs with LEVL1/2, two stations and one seed. The inert Task B does not model competing live repair demand.

The experiment does not separate the TLID label from the linked numeric LEVL mapping. Category interactions, simultaneous three-allocation POINT selection, <NONE> reorder, generic station routing, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
